# @arki/auth

> Sign-in for Arki apps: one `defineAuth` declaration, one `createAuth` factory on Postgres, and a principal whose user type comes from your own table. Better Auth 1.7.7 is the engine, kept behind this API; it is not a general Better Auth wrapper.

The old API (`defineAuthBackend`, `./schema`, `./create-auth` and the rest) is still exported while apps move. New code uses only the entries in the first group below. See [the migration guide](docs/migration.md).

## Import paths
- `@arki/auth`: `defineAuth`, `AUTH_ERROR_CODES`, `AuthError`, `isAuthError`, `PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH`, `AUTH_SECRET_MIN_LENGTH`, and the types `AuthDefinition`, `AuthMethod`, `SocialMethod`, `Principal`, `PrincipalOf`, `AuthContext`.
- `@arki/auth/pg`: `createAuth`, `createAuthTables`, `auth*Columns`, `*IdColumns`, `assertAuthSecret`, `additionalFieldsFromColumns`, and the types `Auth`, `AuthBindings`, `AuthDb`, `AuthEvents`.
- `@arki/auth/pg/workspaces`: `createWorkspaceTables` and the scoping kernel (`workspaceReadFilter`, `resolveWriteScope`, `canSeeRow`, `reassignScope`).
- `@arki/auth/dot`: `auth`, `AuthOf`.
- `@arki/auth/orpc`: `guards`, `assertFound`, `assertOwnedOrNotFound`, `assertOwnedOrForbidden`.
- `@arki/auth/http`: `withPrincipal`, `withOptionalPrincipal`.
- `@arki/auth/ids`: id types and `create*Id` (browser-safe).
- `@arki/auth/zod`: `userIdSchema`, `sessionIdSchema`, `accountIdSchema`, `verificationIdSchema`, `roleIdSchema`, `permissionIdSchema`, `organizationIdSchema`, `teamIdSchema`, `emailSchema`.
- `@arki/auth/password`: `hashPassword`, `verifyPassword`.
- `@arki/auth/workspaces`: `WorkspaceRole`, `rankRole`, `roleAtLeast`, `scopeLevel`, `WorkspaceScopeError`; types `WorkspaceContext`, `Scope`, `OrganizationId`, `TeamId`.
- `@arki/auth/testing`: `testAuth`, `actingAs`, `lastLink`, `lastMagicLink`.
- `@arki/auth/testing/tanstack-start`: `createE2EHandler`. `@arki/auth/testing/production-boot`: `assertAuthBoots`. `@arki/auth/testing/playwright`: browser test helpers.
- `@arki/auth/tanstack-start`: `tanstackStart`, `createRequireAuth`, `ArkiAuthProvider`, `TanStackAuthProvider`. `@arki/auth/react`: `createAuthClient`, `SignInForm`, `createSignInHandlers`, `resolveAuthClientBaseUrl`. `@arki/auth/react/templates`: page templates.
- `@arki/auth/env`, `@arki/auth/tweaks-column`: unchanged helpers.

## Rules that bite
- Read the caller with `auth.principal(headers)`. Never call the engine (`auth.engine`, `better-auth`) from app code.
- The table makes every id (`generateId: false`). An id column without a `$defaultFn` breaks sign-up.
- Production needs `rateLimit: { store: kv }`, a secret of 32+ characters, and `mail` when a method sends mail. Each one missing fails at boot.
- `user.fields` names columns that exist on your user table. Types come from the table, never from the definition.
- `workspaces` needs the workspace tables and the `activeOrganizationId` and `activeTeamId` session columns (`ARKI_AUTH_E007`).
- A cookie and a bearer token on one request is `ARKI_AUTH_E401`, not the cookie's user.
